cultural.vision_reason: A hand-woven strip-weave cotton and silk textile with indigo and magenta supplementary-weft patterning, consistent with Jukun narrow-strip cloth production in Nigeria; strip weaving for larger cloths is a known Jukun craft.

physical.title: cloth
physical.summary: Cloth: a strip of hand-spun and hand-woven cotton and silk, a length of strip-weave which was intended for a larger cloth. The ground weave is of white cotton in both warp and weft. Over this have been added pattern blocks of discontinuous supplementary weft in dark indigo cotton and magenta alaari silk. The indigo and magenta blocks alternate along the strip, abutting each other, and form a pattern of five thick lines of colour along the centre, with triangular shapes continuing on either side to the edge of the strip. One end is the original warp end  left loose; the other end has been cut so that perhaps only half the original length remains.
